priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Failure safety and unattended permissions

tests.name: RunSkill_WithAuthenticationFailure_LogsSanitizedFailure
tests.description: Authentication and other subprocess failures fail the Activity without copying potentially sensitive subprocess output into activity.log.
tests.arrange: A Harness returns a nonzero authentication failure containing a credential marker.
tests.assert: SkillActivityError is raised, a stable harness-failure event identifies the skill and exit code, and credential-bearing stdout or stderr is absent from the Activity log.

tests.name: Run_WithUnstartableDevinProcess_ReportsSanitizedLaunchFailure
tests.description: An executable startup failure is reported without leaking operating-system details or claiming completion.
tests.arrange: A DevinHarness runner raises OSError containing a sensitive filesystem marker.
tests.act: Run the Harness inside an Activity log context.
tests.assert: A sanitized launch error is raised and logged with canonical skill and stable category, while no completion event, artifact success, or sensitive marker is recorded.

tests.name: RunSkill_WithAutoAndMissingSentinel_FailsWithoutEscalation
tests.description: A zero-exit auto invocation that cannot write its artifact remains a failure and is never retried with broader permissions.
tests.arrange: An unconfigured skill resolves to auto and its captured runner exits zero without creating a sentinel.
tests.act: Run the Skill Activity through DevinHarness.
tests.assert: The Activity raises missing-sentinel SkillActivityError and exactly one command ran with auto and no broader mode.

tests.name: RunSkill_ForEachStoryAnalysisSkill_UsesConfiguredProfileAndArtifactContract
tests.description: All four Story Analysis skills use their canonical configured profile while preserving existing sentinel output lookup.
tests.arrange: The repository configuration, a captured Devin runner, and valid sentinels for each canonical Story Analysis skill.
tests.act: Run each representative Skill Activity through DevinHarness.
tests.assert: Each command uses the expected model and accept-edits mode, and each Activity returns the output path from its existing verify_params key.

tests.name: Documentation_ForHarnessProfiles_ExplainsFirstSliceContract
tests.description: Operator documentation is sufficient to configure a least-privilege default and writer override.
tests.arrange: The first-slice orchestrator documentation and repository example configuration.
tests.act: Review the documented shape, precedence, modes, compatibility, unknown-key behavior, safe logging, local examples, and deferred retry snapshot.
tests.assert: Every required topic is documented and the accept-edits example resolves to the expected effective profile.

tests.name: OrchestratorSuite_WithProfileConfiguration_PassesWithoutRegression
tests.description: The completed first slice preserves all orchestrator behavior outside deferred Cadence retry snapshots.
tests.arrange: All focused verification tests and the full orchestrator test suite.
tests.act: Run both suites in the repository Nix environment.
tests.assert: All tests pass with no changes to Cadence retry-snapshot transport.
